The central contracted exact all-policy frontier, convergence, matching converse and sharp learning rate remain open; independent terminal review confirms faithful incremental work below the fixed field floor, with re-raise status. tldr: The original vector Horvitz--Thompson estimator is unbiased for the realized finite-cohort effect, and its error matrix has an exact sequential covariance reduction. Pairing and common-prefix witnesses give nonvanishing lower prices. A new rational response and calibration construction give \(\limsup_nR_n\le V_{\mathrm{resp}}\le9031/6840<4/3\), where the auxiliary response value is computable to any supplied tolerance. The construction includes executable original-record policies and explicit cohort thresholds. The exact all-policy frontier, its convergence, a matching legal-table converse and a sharp learning rate remain open.
gap: Ravichandran et al. remove unavailable effect heterogeneity before optimizing covariance. Scalar design-based Neyman regret can cancel a design-invariant scalar term. Those operations do not evaluate the price of retaining an unknown matrix inside the largest eigenvalue and the full-table oracle minimization.
fill: The sharp all-policy oracle price is paired with an original-record attaining design and a legal fixed-table converse. Separate benchmarks measure pairing ambiguity and unknown future composition; effective signal-learning bounds determine the finite-cohort remainder.
